source.dataset_title: Improving Real-World Execution of Optimized Trading Schedules for Large-Scale Battery Storage Systems through Data-Driven Component Parametrization: Dataset
source.article_title: Improving real-world execution of optimized trading schedules for large-scale battery storage systems through data-driven component parametrization
source.staging_note: Public record and direct ZIP URL verified, but this execution environment returned an unsupported application/zip response and DNS resolution prevented direct download. No archive bytes or content hashes are claimed.

asset_scope.experimental_scope: LMO subsystem used for the two schedule-execution validation tests described in the article

frozen_claims_from_article.note: These values describe the cited M5BAT study and its selected LMO test scope. They are reference targets, not Symthaea results or universal industry limits.

evaluation_protocol.leakage_rule: No Test 2 measurements, fitted parameters or revised data may be used to fit the Test 1-calibrated model. All source and model versions must be content-addressed before the validation replay.
evaluation_protocol.raw_preservation: Preserve the original ZIP and every extracted member unchanged; hash the archive and each data member before parsing.
evaluation_protocol.time_alignment: Preserve source timezone and UTC offset as supplied. Do not normalize time, daylight-saving transitions, gaps or duplicate timestamps before recording the raw mapping.
evaluation_protocol.schedule_mapping: Map each optimized schedule interval to synchronized one-second grid-point measurements, then aggregate using energy integration rather than averaging power values without duration weights.
evaluation_protocol.physical_replay: Compare schedule against grid-connection-point energy; separately evaluate inverter AC/DC efficiency, system SOC drift and individual-unit SOC trajectories.
evaluation_protocol.balancing_cost: Only calculate balancing cost when the required market price/settlement evidence is present in the dataset or separately source-frozen. Never infer a currency charge from energy deviation alone.
evaluation_protocol.capability_envelope: Fit conservative charge/discharge SOC capability curves on Test 1 data only; evaluate envelope coverage, derating decisions and delivery outcomes on Test 2.
evaluation_protocol.minimum_output: Raw digests, schema/column map, time-quality report, data coverage, 15-minute schedule reconciliation, one-second residuals, SOC drift, unfulfilled energy, efficiency errors and an exact reproduction report.

target_gates.first_gate: Reproduce the published Test 1 and Test 2 reference metrics within the dataset's documented rounding/tolerance before claiming any improvement.
critical_constraints: same M5BAT asset/test scope and initial SOC
same schedule horizon and interval alignment
same LMO units and power-delivery boundary
no Test 2 information used in calibration

related_field_datasets.role: high-resolution operational context and component-level replay support
related_field_datasets.asset_scope: 10 M5BAT units, 6.714 MWh subset, Apr 2023; 1-second unit and plant time series
known_caveats: This is a separate public field-data release and is not assumed to be the Applied Energy Test 1/Test 2 archive at DOI 10.18154/RWTH-2025-06555.
Plant BESS.csv is the point-of-connection measurement; BattN files are battery-unit/inverter measurements.
The SOC fields are BMS/system estimates, not independent measurements.
Ambient temperature is not cell temperature.
M5BAT_P and BESS point-of-connection sign is documented with negative charging and positive discharging.
M5BAT unit Pb1 is separately counted in m5bat-pbacid; do not double-count.

related_field_datasets.role: long-horizon flooded lead-acid degradation and operational-state context
related_field_datasets.asset_scope: one M5BAT Pb1 flooded lead-acid string; 1.066 MWh; 2017-2025
known_caveats: Processed data rather than raw manufacturer exports.
Short gaps under 5 seconds were forward-filled; the exported data do not label each filled row.
SOC is a proprietary BMS estimate, not an independent calibrated measurement.
Some cumulative energy counters reset and must be analysed with period-to-period differences.
The flag semantics and data quality require the published codebook and schema.

related_field_datasets.role: multi-technology stationary storage external validation cohort
related_field_datasets.asset_scope: 11 stationary storage systems; 9 have stated or computed energy ratings totalling 63.87 MWh; LFP, NMC, LMO/NMC and vanadium flow
known_caveats: Nine of eleven systems have energy values; two are unrated.
Data are system/pack-level; no individual cell-voltage channels are released.
One system has a documented overlap with the PPL release and is counted only once in registry totals.
EPRI_LFP3 energy is computed from power and E/P assumptions, not a stated nameplate; preserve this uncertainty.

related_field_datasets.role: African distributed stationary-storage transferability cohort; not a grid-scale BESS comparator
related_field_datasets.asset_scope: 1,027 lead-acid off-grid/distributed batteries; approximately 0.24648 MWh computed from stated 12 V / 20 Ah configuration
related_field_datasets.use_boundary: Non-commercial only unless a separate commercial license is obtained. Do not mix these off-grid fleet observations into the M5BAT grid-scale dispatch score.

acquisition_policy: Acquire the Applied Energy Test 1/Test 2 archive as the primary schedule-execution benchmark; keep it distinct from the April 2023 registry release until archive member manifests prove overlap.
Use m5bat-2023-04 for high-resolution POC, per-unit power, SOC and converter-mode checks, not as a substitute for the paper's separate calibration/validation tests.
Use PNNL/EPRI as a technology-transfer validation set with chemistry-stratified cohorts; do not aggregate all systems into one error score.
Use Aitio only for non-commercial African distributed-storage transferability research unless commercial reuse rights are separately obtained.
Store all raw archives outside the public repo; preserve original bytes, per-member SHA-256, publisher DOI, acquisition timestamp, license and immutable extraction manifest before parsing.
field_data_registry_context.claim_boundary: The registry is a discovery catalogue and its headline totals are not a validation result. No candidate archive in this registry context is marked as staged by this record; source files must be acquired, digested and independently checked before any raw-field metric is claimed.
